codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: What are the working Command An Army codes?
items.answer: As of September 19, 2026, seven codes are working: CONQUER, COMMANDER, SHIELDBREAKER, SORRY, OPTIMIZE, WAR, and RELEASE — together 3,500+ Gems. See the codes page for the full list with sources and expiry status.

items.question: What is the best unit in Command An Army?
items.answer: Spartans — the consensus top pick in every September 2026 creator tier list, thanks to shields that push through ranged fire. Lancers are the second consensus pick as the fastest rush unit.

items.question: How do I start Command An Army?
items.answer: Finish the tutorial, redeem all working codes for 3,500+ Gems, summon your first units, and build a four-unit loadout with two or three types. The beginner guide walks through the first hour step by step.

items.question: Is Command An Army free to play?
items.answer: Yes — the game is free on Roblox, and the developer (Fight, Fight, Fight!) regularly hands out Gems through codes, quests, and milestone rewards. No purchase is needed to summon units.
